display.explanation: A time to pray for the unity of Christians and their shared witness to Christ.
display.prompt: Pray for unity among Christians and for our shared witness to Christ.

sentences.label: Sentence
sentences.text: May the God of steadfastness and encouragement grant us to live in harmony with one another in accord with Christ Jesus, so that together we may with one voice glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

sentences.label: Post-communion sentence
sentences.text: There is one body and one Spirit, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all, who is above all and through all and in all.
